remarks: Cheerful four-bedroom 2 bathroom colonial with bright living space, vaulted ceilings, brand new flooring, stainless steel appliances, updated second-floor bath equipped with a steam shower, and a fully fenced-in back yard perfect for privacy. Fourth bedroom on first floor could double as an office or playroom. 24 Herman is tucked away on a quiet walkable street between Noroton and Darien train stations, just around 45 minutes to Grand Central. A short stroll to the vibrant new Noroton Heights downtown area, featuring popular restaurants and shopping.
